originality.rationale: The only identified general coverage is the existence of fixed or period-two behavior, not exact crown-graph first-entry counts, a parity gap, the exact basin sizes, or the asymptotics. The original 2015 voting-time paper and the 1988 cyclic majority paper were inspected in their accessible full text; the 1980 source is credited but full text was not accessible. Published crown-graph results returned by the database concern graph colorings or domination, rather than synchronous majority dynamics. This is best-knowledge originality rather than a proof of uniqueness.
residual_risks: Unindexed or otherwise inaccessible earlier crown-graph majority census remains possible.
The foundational 1980 threshold article was not available in full; its general result is acknowledged, but exact special-case content is a material-read limitation.
The public date 2015-08-14 is the oldest verified day-specific online methodological source in this record; the older 1980/1988 works have verified years without an inspected earliest-public day.

value.rationale: Canonical highly symmetric near-complete bipartite graph family exhibits a sharp tie-induced parity transition in its exact first-periodic-entry clock and a polynomial-vs-exponential initial-recurrence law. Complete labelled temporal populations, one unique odd two-cycle versus many even cycles, and exact eventual basin sizes are natural nontrivial invariants that sharpen general threshold results.
